summary.text: The noble gases are group 18 of the periodic table: helium, neon, argon, krypton, xenon and radon, plus oganesson in some cases.
Under standard conditions the first six are odorless, colorless, monatomic gases with very low chemical reactivity.
Their inertness comes from a full outer shell of valence electrons, which makes them useful whenever chemical reactions are unwanted.

facts.label: First compound
facts.value: Xenon hexafluoroplatinate, found by Neil Bartlett in 1962

items.prompt: Argon is used to shield welds and to fill old-style light bulbs. What quality of the gas makes it suitable?

options.label: It burns very brightly
It rarely reacts with other substances
It is heavier than most metals
It carries heat away quickly

items.explain: Noble gases are useful whenever chemical reactions are unwanted, and argon is used as a shielding gas in welding and as a filler gas in incandescent bulbs.

items.prompt: What about a noble gas atom explains why it rarely joins in chemical reactions?

options.label: It has no electrons to share
Its nucleus is unusually heavy
It carries a strong positive charge
Its outer shell of valence electrons is full

items.explain: Their inertness results from their electron configuration: a full outer shell gives them little tendency to react.

items.prompt: Noble gases only turn liquid at extremely low temperatures. What explains it?

options.label: The pull between their atoms is very weak
Their atoms are too heavy to move
Their atoms bond strongly in pairs
They have too few protons to hold electrons

items.explain: The intermolecular force between noble gas atoms is the very weak London dispersion force, so their boiling points are all cryogenic.

items.prompt: Lord Rayleigh found that nitrogen taken from air had a different density from nitrogen made in chemical reactions. What explained the mismatch?

options.label: Air nitrogen had absorbed water vapor
A heavier isotope of nitrogen was present
The nitrogen from air was mixed with another gas
The chemically made nitrogen had leftover oxygen

items.explain: He and Ramsay theorized the nitrogen from air was mixed with another gas, and isolated a new element, argon.

items.prompt: Chemists now prefer the name noble gas to the older name inert gas. Why was the older label dropped?

options.label: The gases proved to be radioactive
Many compounds of them are now known
They turned out to be liquids at room temperature
The gases became easy to find

items.explain: The inert gas label is deprecated because many noble gas compounds are now known.

items.prompt: Astronomers spotted helium in 1868 while observing the chromosphere. What does its name mean?

options.label: The Greek word for the Sun
The Greek word for lazy
The Greek word for new
The Greek word for hidden

items.explain: Helium was named after the Greek word for the Sun.
